snippet.title: Move 'n' Bloom - out now!
snippet.description:
A simple but also challenging puzzle game about moving, pushing and matching colors. 

Get it on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315710/Move_n_Bloom/

or on itch.io https://waldemar-umaniz.itch.io/move-n-bloom
